records.instructions: Inspect the fire alarm control panel; confirm no fault conditions and that all zones report normal. Photograph the panel status.
Trigger-test each smoke detector and verify it activates the alarm. Log any unit that fails to respond.

records.task_title: Fire Extinguisher Pressure and Expiry Check
records.instructions: Check each extinguisher gauge, pin, seal and inspection tag. Flag any expired unit for replacement.
Replace expired extinguishers and refill discharged units. Confirm new units are mounted and tagged.

records.task_title: Test Emergency Lighting and Exit Signs
records.instructions: Verify emergency lights and illuminated exit signs operate on backup power and remain visible.
Confirm alarm system control switches are in the ready position and the system is armed and operational.
Start and observe the external fire-water pump; verify pressure is achieved and there are no leaks.

records.task_title: Inspect Gas Stove and Lines for Leaks
records.instructions: Check stoves, hoses and LPG cylinder connections for gas leaks. Any detected leak is an urgent finding requiring same-day isolation and repair.

records.task_title: Verify Evacuation Plan Posted and Clear
records.instructions: Confirm the evacuation plan is posted at designated locations, legible, and understood by occupants.

records.task_title: First Aid Kit Inventory and Expiry Check
records.instructions: Check first-aid kit contents and replace expired or missing items so every kit is fully stocked.

records.task_title: Same-Day Escalation of Active Safety Hazard
records.instructions: On discovery of an active hazard, escalate to management the same day with photos; do not hold for the weekly report cycle.

records.task_title: Fire Incident Civil Defense Report Follow-up
records.instructions: After any fire incident, request the Civil Defense report and delegation letter and pass the documentation to the insurance follow-up.

records.task_title: Air Conditioner Cleaning and Cooling Check
records.instructions: Clean AC filters and coils and confirm adequate cooling. Log dirty units needing service.

records.task_title: Electrical Switch and Socket Safety Inspection
records.instructions: Inspect switches, sockets and exposed wiring for damage or overheating. Replace faulty switches that fail.
Check taps, mixers, bidet sprays and WC siphons for leaks or missing fixtures and raise repairs.
Clean kitchen and bathroom exhaust/ventilation fans and confirm they draw air effectively.
After repairing a reported finding, re-inspect and close it with before/after photos confirming the fix.
Clean rooms, corridors, kitchens and bathrooms and submit the dated daily cleaning report with photos to the supervisor.
Perform the monthly IPM treatment (spray, gel bait, rodent control) across rooms and facilities and retain the signed service receipt.
Carry out the quarterly bed-bug treatment of beds and mattresses per the pest-control contract.

records.task_title: Install Insect Killer Machines in Kitchens
records.instructions: On a client safety complaint, procure and install insect-killer machines in accommodation kitchens and confirm placement.

records.task_title: Water Tank Cleanliness and Integrity Inspection
records.instructions: Inspect water tanks for leaks, contamination and structural integrity; schedule cleaning where needed.
Confirm all CCTV cameras are functional and the recorder is capturing and retaining footage.
Check that mandated safety signs and emergency-exit signage are installed, intact and visible across the site.
Compile the week's fire-safety and maintenance inspection findings into the official field report and submit to management.
Keep the HSE policy pack (safety, emergency action, fire protection, first aid, PPE, incident reporting, etc.) current for client and vendor audits.

records.task_title: Third Party Safety and Health Compliance Audit
records.instructions: Coordinate the client-required third-party safety/health audit and submit the requested compliance documents.
Track the Civil Defense and municipal licenses and initiate renewal before expiry to keep the site compliant.

records.task_title: Conduct and Document Fire and Evacuation Drill
records.instructions: Execute a planned fire/evacuation drill per the documented drill schedule. Record assembly-point photos, the evacuated headcount against the resident roster, and evacuation timing. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding / Fire Protection Policy.
After each drill, hold a post-drill evaluation and briefing with residents to review the process, capture observations, and reinforce emergency procedures. File the evaluation note as evidence.

Record each extinguisher's pressure, pin, seal and tag in a dated inspection log per the standing inspection schedule; service or replace any out-of-pressure unit. Required by client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit findings (out-of-pressure / non-functional extinguishers).

records.task_title: Fire Safety Training with Attendance Records
records.instructions: Deliver fire safety training covering emergency procedures, fire-equipment use and emergency protocols. Retain training content, trainer details, dates and attendance roster. This is distinct from an evacuation drill: per the client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit a drill does not satisfy the training requirement.
Issue required personal protective equipment and train workers on correct selection and use; record issuance and training attendance. Per AFMCO PPE Policy.
Brief all workers that any person may stop work on observing an unsafe condition without penalty, and on how to escalate. Per AFMCO Stop Work Authorization Policy.

records.task_title: Chemical Safety and SDS Handling Training
records.instructions: Train staff handling cleaning and pest-control chemicals on safe storage, labelling and Safety Data Sheet access; confirm SDS are available on site. Per AFMCO Chemical Safety Policy.
Communicate the Drug and Alcohol Policy and collect signed worker acknowledgements. Per AFMCO Drug and Alcohol Policy.

Maintain a documented cleaning assessment checklist posted inside each bathroom, signed off daily by the assigned cleaner and verified weekly by facility management. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

Verify kitchen insect traps are functional and replace failed units, and confirm all trash bins are covered to prevent pest and vermin ingress. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

records.task_title: Refrigerator Deep Clean and Hygiene Check
records.instructions: Deep-clean all shared refrigerators and confirm hygienic condition with no pest presence; photograph before/after. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

records.task_title: Provide Water Coolers and Certified Water Quality Analysis
records.instructions: Ensure potable water coolers are provided in the accommodation and obtain a water quality analysis from a certified laboratory; retain the lab report. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

records.task_title: Verify One Personal Locker Per Worker
records.instructions: Confirm each worker is provided one personal lockable locker for secure storage of belongings, and raise procurement where short. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

records.task_title: Building Deterioration and Structural Hazard Inspection
records.instructions: Inspect for cracks and structural deterioration (e.g. staircase holes, damaged ceilings/walls at pipework, open holes at AC openings and emergency-exit doors) and seal them to remove trip/fall hazards and pest/dust ingress. Required by a client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit finding.

records.task_title: Hand and Power Tool Safety Inspection
records.instructions: Inspect hand and power tools for damage, guarding and safe condition; remove defective tools from service. Per AFMCO Tool Safety Policy.
Assess noise exposure in plant/generator and equipment areas and apply controls or hearing protection where thresholds are exceeded. Per AFMCO Noise Exposure Policy.

Review and re-date the site Emergency Action Plan (alarm, evacuation routes, assembly points, roles) with signatures; ensure it matches the current accommodation. Per AFMCO Emergency Action Plan Policy.

records.task_title: Obtain and Maintain Balady Municipality Certificate
records.instructions: Obtain and keep valid building permits and the Balady (municipality) certificate from local authorities, and provide them as audit evidence. Required by client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit findings (no valid Balady certificate / building-code compliance).

Keep the required health-and-safety accreditation current by completing the accreditation body's auditor-assigned compliance tasks; this accreditation is a mandatory requirement to continue working with the client.

records.task_title: Maintain Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment Register
records.instructions: Maintain a hazard identification, risk assessment and control register for the site and review it after any change or incident. Per AFMCO Hazard Identification, Risk Assessment and Control Policy.
Pre-qualify pest-control, cleaning and maintenance subcontractors on safety, verify licences/insurance, and retain their service reports. Per AFMCO Subcontractor Safety Management Policy.

For each open client audit finding, assemble the corrective-action evidence (photos, certificates, logs, service reports) named per the client's evidence-submission framework and submit by the finding due date. Based on the client warehouse-safety (WHS) audit remediation process.

Retain safety records (drills, training, inspections, incidents, audits) for the period set in the Records Retention Policy and keep them retrievable for client audits. Per AFMCO Records Retention Policy.
